team.text: The project was created by Shahin Talaei.
The project is based in Toronto, Canada.
InsightAI is a cognitive AI that runs on personal hardware rather than in the cloud or a data center.
The creator of InsightAI began building the AI after recognizing a shift in AI engines' capabilities.
The creator of InsightAI experimented with various AI systems including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok.
The codebase for InsightAI includes a Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Every Founder Edition Lifetime License for InsightAI is numbered, with only one N° 001 available.
The project is led by a solo founder.
The project is created by Shahin Talaei.
